NVIDIA Profile Inspector 3.0.2.1

Upstream: https://github.com/Orbmu2k/nvidiaProfileInspector
License: MIT (see LICENSE.txt)

The executable, configuration file and Reference.xml were taken from the
locally installed 1U 2.8.0 package, which identifies its NVIDIA Profile
Inspector build as upstream commit bedb800569384eda737cb7aa596fbd97b5d6863c.
The original 1U NVIDIA preset files are not redistributed here. Qingchang
generates its own small NIP profiles from named setting targets.
